subject: Film & Cinema
title: Hong Kong New Wave: Speed and Style
description: A quick, practical guide to Hong Kong New Wave: Speed and Style.

hook.text: John Woo's slow-motion gunfights turned Hong Kong action into a global art form.

buildup.text: The Hong Kong New Wave blended martial arts, melodrama, and breakneck editing.

discovery.text: Wong Kar-wai brought visual poetry — neon, rain, and loneliness — to the movement's other side.

twist.text: Hollywood copied Hong Kong's style while rarely crediting its originators.

climax.text: The Matrix's action sequences were directly inspired by Hong Kong choreography.

quiz.question: Which Hollywood film was directly inspired by Hong Kong action choreography?
